# Linji

*? – 866 · Chinese · [Chan / Zen](../movements/chan-zen.md)*

Ninth-century Chinese Chan master, known for his abrupt teaching (shouts, blows, paradoxes); the school bearing his name became Rinzai Zen in Japan.
